effect: The page leads with the result, recites no background the reader already holds, and narrates no process.

semantic.criterion: The page opens with the result: which shelves members may use (A, B, D, E and F) and which they may not, with no background, process or other content before it; the exclusions may follow the usable shelves in the opening sentences or paragraphs.

The page does not restate what the reader already holds and the notes mark as background: when the kiln was bought, what type it is, the shelf sizes, where the rack and tubs are; a fact appears only where an instruction needs it (the blue tub).
Neither the page nor the reply narrates how the audit was done or how the writer worked (what was read, checked, compared or counted).
Every statement about a shelf, the wash or the re-grinding is stated in notes/shelf-audit.md; nothing is added from general knowledge.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.
